quests.name: The Giant Rats
quests.description: Get rid of those giant rats in their giant rat hiole

steps.name: Step 1 Kill the Cave Rats
steps.description: Kill the Giant Rats in the cave under the shop

steps.name: Step 2: Kill the Basement Rats!!!
steps.description: Kill the rats inthe basement too!!!!!

steps.name: Step 3: Deal with the rats around Hallowmere
Step 4: Find and Stop the Goblin Trouble Makers

quest_giver.start_dialog: I'm the owner of the General Shop and my basement is infested with Giant Rats. Can you take care of this problem for me? I fear that the infestation is spreading and I blame those goblins that have been sneaking around.
quest_giver.end_dialog: Thank you so much for getting rid of those rats and dealing with that cave system... Who knew?

quests.name: Chase the Goblins Away
quests.description: The town has learned that the Giant Rat infestation started with the goblins in their grotto just north of town. We suspect they have been burrowing into town, probably near the general shop. Go and chase them out!

steps.name: Remove the Goblin Squatters from the Grotto
Return the Chest
steps.description: The goblins have  taken the town treasury! Find it and return it to the mayor.

quest_giver.start_dialog: The town has learned that the Giant Rat infestation started with the goblins in their grotto just north of town. We suspect they have been burrowing into town, probably near the general shop. Go and chase them out!
quest_giver.end_dialog: Thank you brave traveler. I assumed you would have returned, dead and floating by town but you have prevailed! You have the town's thanks!.

quests.name: Explore the Grotto
quests.description: There is another grotto just north of the goblins, explore that and make sure it does not pose a menace to Hallowmere

quest_giver.start_dialog: There is another grotto just north of the goblins, explore that and make sure it does not pose a menace to Hallowmere
quest_giver.end_dialog: Looks like my suspicion was correct, please accept the thanks of the people of Hallowmere

quest_giver.start_dialog: I have heard that there is a forest just north of us with great treasure lurking in the shadows. Can you help map out the dark forest?
quest_giver.end_dialog: This is amazing, I had no idea how far the forest reached. You will be rewarded.

quest_giver.start_dialog: What's happening with these pirate raids? And in Hallowmere of all places. My entire troop was robbed by pirates right over there in that lake! I don't know where they are coming from, but I suspect it's that unsavory inn.
quest_giver.end_dialog: You are my true hero, I will somersault back to my place and get the rest my troop. The town owes you a debt, but that's not something I can pay out. bye bye!
